data.desc: Cabaletta Bio (Nasdaq: CABA) is a late-stage clinical biotechnology company focused on developing and launching curative targeted cell therapies designed specifically for patients with autoimmune diseases. Cabaletta's lead product candidate, resecabtagene autoleucel (rese-cel), is an investigational 4-1BB-containing fully human CD19-CAR T cell therapy being advanced across the REstoring SElf-Tolerance (RESET) clinical development program spanning multiple therapeutic areas, including rheumatology, neurology, and dermatology.
